svg.text: Godin Bremond 1, Canon FD · torch → 35 mm film strip → SLR lens
SECTION A-A CONNECTOR, CANON FD, FILM
1. Every dimension here is read from src/*.scad when the sheet is drawn. Redraw with `make schematic`.
2. REGISTER is film (the strip on its ledges) to lens flange face, and is the one dimension that must be right. Drawn 40,
UNDER the nominal Canon FD 42.0: a focus ring only ever adds extension, so a short register is recovered by focusing
closer and a long one is not.
3. Mount bore ⌀48.5, ring ⌀51.6, tabs ⌀54. Tab layout after the MakerWorld rear cap 614033, trimmed on the lens with
gauges C and D (src/plates/plate_fd_d.scad). Bore 0.5 under gauge fd_d5, which fit with the bore a hair wide. Ring
2.25 above the flange face leaves 0.45 of claw clearance at the tab root.
4. Print upright as modelled, no support. Overhangs: the 1.1 mm tab undersides, the lips' quarter-ellipse undersides, and
the ledge undersides, one straight ramp at 34° to the bed.
5. Olympus OM (src/connector_om.scad) is still the slide-slot body with an OM head; there is no film version yet.
